name: Water basin
description: A stone basin of water with a drain, a valve to open it and a pressure plate on the floor of the basin. Turn the valve and the water runs out; once the level is below the plate the plate can be reached and weighted. The valve is a lever, so Mage Hand works from across the room.

brim.description: Height of the basin's rim above its floor.

depth.description: How deep the water stands at the start (not above the brim).

drainRate.description: How fast the level falls while the valve is open.

plateWeight.description: Weight that turns the floor plate on.

inputs.name: valve
inputs.description: The lever opens the drain and closing it stops the flow.

outputs.name: valve-open
outputs.description: On while the valve is open and the basin draining.

outputs.name: plate-pressed
outputs.description: On while enough weight rests on the basin-floor plate.
